note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Verhofstadt I liberal-socialist-green coalition), not measured data. Influence reflects a judgement of institutional weight in a consensus democracy with strong social partners (unions and employers), a press split by language, and a civilian-controlled military.
